skill.description: Automate YouTube uploads, metadata updates, playlists, search, analytics, subscriptions, and comments through Rube MCP and Composio.
skill.summary: Coordinate common YouTube channel workflows through Rube MCP tools.

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown backticks around tool names, parameters, and examples. The audit confirms a disclosed remote MCP endpoint and a medium contextual risk from OAuth-backed YouTube account actions.

remediation.suggestion: Disclose what data Rube MCP may receive and require users to review the endpoint before connecting it.
Add explicit confirmation guidance before uploads, metadata updates, playlist edits, subscription changes, or public publishing.
Keep the instruction to search current Rube tool schemas before every workflow and validate write-action parameters.

static_findings.snippet: - Active YouTube connection via `RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS` with toolkit `youtube`
- Always call `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` first to get current tool schemas
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
1. Verify Rube MCP is available by confirming `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` responds
- `categoryId`: YouTube category ID (e.g., '22' for People & Blogs)
- `videoFilePath`: Object with `{name, mimetype, s3key}` for the video file
- Angle brackets `< >` in tags are automatically stripped
2. `YOUTUBE_VIDEO_DETAILS` - Get full details for a specific video [Optional]
- `q`: Search query (supports exact phrases, exclusions, channel handles)
3. `YOUTUBE_ADD_VIDEO_TO_PLAYLIST` - Add a video to a playlist [Optional]
- `playlistId`: Playlist ID ('PL...' for user-created, 'UU...' for uploads)
1. `YOUTUBE_GET_CHANNEL_ID_BY_HANDLE` - Resolve a handle to channel ID [Prerequisite]
3. `YOUTUBE_LIST_CHANNEL_VIDEOS` - List all videos from a channel [Optional]
- `id`: Comma-separated video IDs for batch details
- Response data may be nested under `data` or `data_preview`; parse defensively
- Pass token as `pageToken` in next request
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
- items[].id is not the videoId; use items[].snippet.resourceId.videoId
- Monitor quota usage to avoid hitting daily limits

content.user_title: Automate YouTube Workflows with Rube MCP
content.value_statement: YouTube channel work often spans uploads, playlists, analytics, and comments. This skill organizes those tasks through current Rube MCP YouTube tools.
actual_capabilities: Guides Rube MCP setup and YouTube OAuth connection checks.
Lists tool sequences for uploads, metadata updates, and thumbnails.
Explains search, video details, batch details, and pagination workflows.
Covers playlist creation, playlist item listing, and uploads playlist conversion.
Supports channel statistics, activities, subscriptions, and comment thread lookup.
limitations: Requires Rube MCP and an active YouTube OAuth connection.
Does not include executable scripts or local automation code.
Depends on current Rube tool schemas and YouTube API quotas.
Cannot bypass YouTube permissions, privacy rules, verification, or disabled comments.

use_cases.title: Publish Channel Videos
use_cases.description: Prepare uploads, metadata, tags, privacy settings, and thumbnail updates with clear tool sequencing.

use_cases.title: Review Channel Performance
use_cases.description: Resolve channel IDs, gather statistics, fetch video details, and summarize channel activity.

use_cases.title: Maintain Playlists and Comments
use_cases.description: List playlists, add videos, inspect playlist items, and retrieve comment threads for review.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Private Upload
prompt_templates.prompt: Search the current Rube YouTube tools. Prepare a private video upload with title, description, tags, category, and thumbnail steps. Ask before publishing.

prompt_templates.title: Clean Up a Playlist
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the current playlist tools to list my playlists, find the target playlist, review items, and suggest changes before editing anything.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Recent Channel Performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Resolve this channel handle, collect channel statistics, list recent videos, batch fetch video details, and summarize performance with quota notes.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Publishing Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a complete YouTube publishing workflow using current Rube schemas. Include upload, metadata update, thumbnail, playlist placement, analytics checks, and confirmation gates.

output_examples.input: Prepare an upload for a private product demo video.
output_examples.output: A private upload plan with required fields, thumbnail steps, quota impact, and a confirmation point before any public release.

output_examples.input: Review a playlist and identify cleanup actions.
output_examples.output: A playlist maintenance summary covering pagination, duplicate checks, missing metadata, and proposed edits that require approval.

output_examples.input: Summarize performance for a channel handle.
output_examples.output: A channel analytics brief with subscriber totals, view totals, recent video metrics, unavailable videos, and quota notes.

best_practices: Search Rube tools first so prompts use current schemas and parameter names.
Confirm account identity, privacy status, and quota cost before write actions.
Use pagination and batch video details to avoid incomplete analysis.
anti_patterns: Publishing or editing public videos without explicit user confirmation.
Passing channel IDs as playlist IDs without converting uploads playlists.
Using raw local file paths when the upload tool expects a prepared file object.

faq.question: Does this skill upload videos by itself?
faq.answer: No. It guides an AI agent to use Rube MCP YouTube tools after the user authorizes the connection.

faq.question: Why should the agent search tools first?
faq.answer: Rube tool schemas can change. Searching first helps the agent use current parameter names and supported actions.

faq.question: Can it manage playlists?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents playlist listing, creation, adding videos, and listing playlist items through YouTube tools.

faq.question: Can it provide analytics?
faq.answer: It can guide channel statistics, activity lookup, video listing, and batch video detail collection where the API allows access.

faq.question: What access is required?
faq.answer: Users need Rube MCP configured and a YouTube OAuth connection with permissions for the requested actions.

faq.question: What should users confirm before write actions?
faq.answer: Confirm the channel, privacy status, target playlist, metadata, quota cost, and whether the action changes public content.
